sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31'
